title: plantcv-mcp: PlantCV as a measurement instrument over the Model Context Protocol, returning traits with the overlay they came from
description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exposing PlantCV as a measurement instrument: it returns plant trait numbers together with the segmentation overlay they were computed from, and refuses to return numbers when the segmentation is degenerate. Mask validity is two-sided, so an inverted threshold - which otherwise reports the background as the plant with no error at all - is an outcome the system can express as a failure. Traits convert to real-world units from an explicit table rather than from PlantCV's unit strings, and batch analysis withholds traits for any image that trips a blocking guard instead of reporting an unreviewed number.
